tools_helpful.evidence: Bootstrap scaffolded the WinUI 3 shell and seeded MIGRATION-MAPPING.md; the agent migrated the namespace + shell without manual copying.

tools_problematic.problem: Agent stayed in a build->edit loop until turn 67 with the build still failing; never reached a clean compile.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log.txt tail shows TURN 67 with 'BluetoothLE ... XamlPreCom' still running and the trial ending; migration-score.json winui_build_status = 'failed: 16 compile errors'.

tool_limitations.limitation: No anchor/pattern exists for member-level missing WinRT APIs (CS1061/CS0117 on a supported type) nor for Application.Suspending/Resuming, so the agent had nothing to fetch when those errors surfaced.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Add both cases to the 'Common build errors' section of MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md (done in this improvement).

failed_apis.why_tried: UWP sample registers suspend/resume handlers in Scenario3/Scenario4 OnNavigatedTo to pause/resume UI updates.
failed_apis.root_cause: WinUI 3 Application has no Suspending/Resuming events (no UWP process-lifetime model on desktop).
failed_apis.fix: Delete the registration/unregistration lines and the handlers; move pause/resume work to OnNavigatedTo/OnNavigatedFrom or Window.Closed.

failed_apis.why_tried: UWP BLE server scenarios set secondary-PHY advertising flags.
failed_apis.root_cause: Member not exposed by the Windows App SDK WinRT projection even on net10.0-windows10.0.26100.0.
failed_apis.fix: Drop the property assignment (extra-advertising behaviour not applied); keep surrounding flow so the file builds.

failed_apis.why_tried: Gate the 2M-PHY UI on adapter capability.
failed_apis.root_cause: Capability flag missing from the projection.
failed_apis.fix: Treat as false (substitute constant) so the existing 'not supported' UI path runs and the file compiles.

failed_apis.root_cause: Method overload missing from the projection.
failed_apis.fix: Drop the call; advertising simply isn't updated at runtime.

special_apis.special_handling: Type family is supported (marked sensitivePresence/SEQUENTIAL) but several newer member-level APIs are absent from the projection; must be stubbed/guarded per-member to keep the build green.

errors_encountered.fix: Substitute false; let existing 'not supported' branch run.

errors_encountered.root_cause: Events do not exist on Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Application.

errors_encountered.error: WMC9999 XAML compiler internal error (NullReferenceException) in MarkupCompilePass2
errors_encountered.root_cause: Downstream symptom: code-behind for scenario pages did not compile, leaving the XAML markup compile in an inconsistent state.
errors_encountered.fix: Resolves once the underlying CS errors are fixed and the code-behind compiles.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Wrapped OnNavigatedTo bodies in try/catch but left Application.Current.Suspending/Resuming and the missing PHY members untouched; build never went green.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: build loop persisted through trial end (turn 67)
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Agent applied the runtime 'defensive UI try/catch' guidance to what were actually compile-time errors (missing members/events), which try/catch cannot fix; and had no skill guidance permitting it to stub a single missing member.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved — trial ended with 16 compile errors; score 0.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Skill guidance that (a) names Application.Suspending/Resuming as removed in WinUI 3, and (b) states that a missing-member compile error must be stubbed/guarded (not try/catch'd) to keep the build green, since a non-building app scores zero.
